name: Xuan Huong Lake
kicker: The lake in the middle of town
summary: Walk or pedal the shore of the lake in the middle of Da Lat. Visit Lâm Đồng lists the water as free. A loop takes 45 to 90 minutes. Bring a layer from November to January, and do not treat the shore as the whole highlands trip.
getThere: In the centre of Da Lat
heroCaption: Xuan Huong Lake and the pines along the bank
body: The shore path is the easy hour in Da Lat. Walk or jog the bank, or rent a pedal boat, and stop when you want tea. Pines and the town edge sit on the water. Visit Lâm Đồng lists the lake as free.

A loop takes 45 to 90 minutes. Late afternoon is the light Vietnam National Authority of Tourism points you toward, and a layer helps from November to January. The waterfalls and Lang Biang are half-day rides out. The lake is not the whole trip. Boat hire is Check on arrival.

figures.caption: Xuan Huong Lake at dusk
figures.alt: Xuan Huong Lake in the evening, with the far bank still visible

gettingThere: The lake is the centre of town. Hotels around the shore walk out onto the path. No ticket gate is printed.

legs.heading: From the market slope
legs.body: Walk down to the water. The market is the uphill neighbour. Minutes are not printed.

admissionNote: Visit Lâm Đồng lists the lake as free to walk. A pedal-boat hire price is not printed. That hire is Check on arrival.
